reason: A dsh plugin that adds AI-assisted image analysis through configurable primary and backup vision-language-model APIs, with web-based settings and automatic failover.

summaries.zh: 通过可配置的视觉语言模型接口为 dsh 提供 AI 图像分析工具，并支持备用接口和设置页面。
summaries.en: Adds an AI image analysis tool to dsh using configurable primary and backup vision-language-model endpoints with a settings page.

capabilities: Analyzes images through an analyze_image tool using configured vision-language-model APIs
Sends image analysis requests to configured primary or backup OpenAI-compatible endpoints
Stores and updates VLM endpoint, model, retry, and API key configuration
Provides web routes and a settings page for VLM configuration and model retrieval
